name: Takatoo Rin
source:
A high school student who got lost in another world.  Her main charm is... positive thinking! 

Not really good at studying, but in order to communicate with Ruka, she attempts to learn Juliamo, the language used by people in the parallel world.

"...Potatoes were apples?!"

[Translated from [url=http://sukerasparo.com/#chara]Official Site[/url]]
